description: This file defines the FreeMarkerViewHandler class, which extends AbstractViewHandler to implement a view handler for the FreeMarker template engine within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initialization, rendering templates, and preparing the data model with OFBiz-specific objects for template processing.

classes.name: FreeMarkerViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler class for processing FreeMarker templates within the OFBiz framework, managing template configuration, rendering, and context preparation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the template configuration with the servlet context, setting cache storage and template loading path.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified FreeMarker template with the given context, handling template loading and output streaming.

methods.name: prepOfbizRoot
methods.description: Prepares the data model for FreeMarker templates by injecting OFBiz-specific objects such as delegator, dispatcher, security, userLogin, and request/response/session objects.
